# FabricOps Starter Kit

> FabricOps Starter Kit helps teams build governed, quality-checked, Microsoft Fabric notebook workflows with reusable helpers, notebook templates, metadata-backed contracts, data quality checks, lineage, and handover evidence.

Use this file as a concise navigation map for documentation and automation workflows. The human-readable documentation is also published with Markdown variants where possible; for example, `/guided-demo/` is available as `/guided-demo.md`.

## Get Started

- [Guided Demo](guided-demo.md): First path through the starter workflow and key concepts.
- [Setup Fabric Artifacts](guided-demo/setup-fabric-artifacts.md): Fabric workspace, published release wheel upload, notebook attachment, import smoke test, and first runtime readiness.

## Architecture

- [How FabricOps Works](how-fabricops-works.md): Overview of the governed Fabric notebook operating model.
- [List of Metadata Tables](reference/metadata.md): Metadata table responsibilities and governance evidence model.
- [Pipeline Execution](guided-demo/run-pipeline.md): Runtime pipeline flow, guardrails, DQ enforcement, and profile behaviour.
- [Metadata Dashboard](notebook-templates-implementation-guide/metadata-dashboard.md): Operational visibility over metadata and governance outputs.

## Notebook flow

- [Templates](notebook-templates-implementation-guide/index.md): Responsibilities of `00_env_config`, agreement, pipeline, governance, and exploration notebooks.
- [Environment Config](guided-demo/run-environment-setup.md): Runtime configuration and metadata target setup for `00_env_config`.
- [Agreement Setup](guided-demo/create-agreement.md): Agreement and steward context setup for governed runs.

## Metadata and contracts

- [Data Quality and Governance](guided-demo/review-guardrails.md): Review flows for column context, classification, DQ rules, and governance evidence.
- [DQ Rules Reference](reference/dq-rules.md): Supported rule types, parameters, examples, and enforcement expectations.

## API reference

- [Function Reference](reference.md): Public callable reference generated from source docstrings and metadata.

## Handover and maintenance

- [Release Guide](maintainer/index.md): Maintainer checklist for release curation, lifecycle decisions, generators, build assets, and GitHub publishing.
- [Public API & Architecture](maintainer/public-api-architecture.md): Maintainer reference for supported API boundaries, call-flow contracts, generated references, and dashboard review.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution workflow and expectations.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md): Repository-level overview and navigation.

## Markdown navigation

- This static navigation file and Markdown page variants support deterministic documentation ingestion.
